effect_description_eng: [Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a Digimon with the [Ice-Snow] trait, gain 1 memory. [All Turns] When your Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [Ice-Snow] trait, by suspending this Tamer, trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards from 1 of your opponent's Digimon. After, if they don't have a Digimon with digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.
security_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
